title: Input facts for stig.oracle_linux_9: DISA STIG, Oracle Linux 9
description: Facts the DISA STIG module for Oracle Linux 9 reads, from its reviewed rule table (114 rules). `required` lists the evidence of rules that always apply: absent or null, the rule is Open with 'evidence missing'.
